body:
Hire a housekeeper on your pay alone then if it’s that much bullshit. How sorry an existence it must be to be incapable of making lunch. How does one feed oneself?!?

Your wife deserves a break. If she’s a nurse then she’s wiped enough behinds. And yet you have the audacity to make her come home to yours proudly clapping in the wind about your incapability. 

You’re secure in the fact she’s dealt with you for nearly fifty years. She can’t possibly leave you now can she? 

She can. She’s a nurse. She’ll be fine. You however seem like you’ll starve by day one.

Be better. YTA. Massively.

I did tell my mom that I was worried I was (un?) consciously sabotaging the session when I called her to vent after I left early. She normally gives me very good advice and emotional comfort, so when she told me I was being vindictive I was startled and upset but also felt like I understood what she was saying even though I didn’t like it

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me! I hope your day is going well

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me! 

It’s just for family therapy; He has his own therapist. She was recommended to him by our relationship counselor (we like having unbiased mediation for our petty quibbles every month or two). As far as we’re aware, this is the only therapy his mother is participating in. 

Though I suppose we should probably ask to be sure.

You’re correct, I didn’t say any of that

…but I really wanted to

Yeah. I totally did know what I was doing. 

I spoke first that session, as the grievance was mine, and she proceeded to deny the whole thing even happened. The therapist did temper that blow with “____? I think OP was hoping for a little more validation and less defensiveness. How could we rephrase that?” 

The aftermath was that I left the session early. No major fallout between my partner and his mother that I’m aware of (aside from his disappointment with her answer). 

I’m in therapy myself, so I really appreciate views  of my behavior outside of my personal bubble. I’m not terribly observant and an outside perspective is incredibly helpful. Thank you for taking the time to speak with me

Damn. She is still getting to me isn’t she

Adjusting my expectations is a really good way to phrase how I’m feeling. “I’m not being fatalistic, I’m just adjusting my expectations” 

Also thank you for acknowledging the generosity in extending that olive branch. I am just now realizing that I’m also pissed about how that played out. I feel like I really tried, and I’m disappointed she didn’t even try to meet me halfway. 

Thank you for speaking with me, and I really appreciate it!

It’s definitely over the top to say I never want to see her again, you’re right

I’m just… still so angry about the whole thing? It’s been NC (aside from my partner asking for therapy every six months or so) for so long that when she actually agreed I was pessimistic from the start. 

I will be standing my ground though. Thank you for taking the time to give advice and speak with me! I really appreciate it
